name: Harley-Davidson Cross Bones
engine: 96 cubic inch Twin Cam B V-twin, fuel injected, belt drive, springer front end
intro: A dark bobber-style Softail with a springer fork. The fork has its own bushings and springs to check.

L: The springer front end pivots on bushings and rockers. Check them for play and grease them before you ride.

recallNote: Harley-Davidson has issued several recalls that touch these years. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before you start.
